TC-09/S06.title: Photo row × All Residents state → outcome
TC-09/S06.detail: Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S06: 19/19 judged pass — '7 residents found'; Fir (known, In Today) stays on today once; Gum (known, not In Today) joins today, unit Birch 2 and MRN kept; the repeated Juniper row went to 'Possible duplicate residents', answered 'Same resident', and Juniper exists once; Kestrel (no unit, no MRN) created with a blank unit and no DOB, Follow-up, no inferred 'Birch 5'; Ivy (known only in Hospital) created as a Nursing Home resident and is still once on the Hospital list, with nothing from Nursing Home on it; every new resident is Follow-up. Recorded: Q2 counts '2 already in All Residents · 4 new · 1 to review'; Q6 Kestrel / Juniper stored with generated 'SNF-' MRNs; Q8 the Hazel row with another MRN created a second 'QA TC-09-S06 Hazel' (In Today) beside the original (not In Today), with no prompt; Q1 the fixture resident left today without a prompt.
